description: Initial prompt template for AI game playing with support for numeric and natural language modes

numeric.description: AI outputs action as numeric ID (Action: 0, 1, 2...)
instruction_template: Your task: Choose the best action for the CURRENT INITIAL STATE shown in the image above.
Your response MUST start with your chosen action on the FIRST LINE in this exact format:
The square brackets [ ] are REQUIRED. The [Action: X] line MUST be the FIRST line of your response.
You may add brief reasoning AFTER the action line.

natural_language.description: AI outputs action as natural language description (Action: FIRE, turn left...)
instruction_template: Your task: Choose the best action for the CURRENT INITIAL STATE shown in the image above.
Your response MUST start with your chosen action on the FIRST LINE in this exact format:
Use the EXACT action names from the list above.
The square brackets [ ] are REQUIRED. The [Action: X] line MUST be the FIRST line of your response.
You may add brief reasoning AFTER the action line.

placeholders.game_rules: Pre-formatted game rules (includes 'Game Rules:' header), empty string if not provided
placeholders.video_context: Pre-formatted example gameplay video description, empty string if not provided
placeholders.action_list: Formatted list of available actions (format depends on mode)

notes: context_template is sent before media; instruction_template is sent after the current-state image
The template list is kept for backwards-compatible full prompt generation
Empty strings in the template create blank lines
action_list_format defines how each action is formatted in the action list
